page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable Markdown rules you attach to agents. Enabled skills are injected into the agent's prompt in the order set on the agent.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a Markdown file or a .zip archive.

card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {No agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface. Write it as a directive: "Flag…", "Reject…", "Require…".
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag changed tests that skip empty, zero, and max-size inputs.
form.bodyHint: Injected verbatim into the prompt of every agent that has this skill enabled.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a .md file or a .zip archive. Only the Markdown core is kept.
import.trustTitle: A third-party skill is third-party instructions
import.trust: Once enabled on an agent, this text becomes part of that agent's prompt. Read it in full before saving. Scripts and other files in an archive are never executed, stored, or sent to a model.
import.readFailed: Could not read this file from disk.

delete.title: Delete skill
delete.body: Delete "{name}"? It will be detached from {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}. This can't be undone.

config.bodyHint: Saving a changed body snapshots it as v{next}.
config.dangerBody: Removes it from every agent it is attached to.

preview.hint: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every body change is stored as an immutable snapshot. Restoring copies an old body into a new version.
versions.restoreBody: The body of v{version} becomes the new current version v{next}. Nothing in the history is deleted.
